rituals.name: Morning blessing

items.item: new clothes for the birthday person
offering as per the family's practice

rituals.significance: Elders bless the birthday person; many families also offer a prayer of thanks for the year.

rituals.name: Guest welcome

items.item: name tags or a guest book

rituals.significance: Guests settle in, greet the birthday person and get photographed.

rituals.name: Games and activities

items.item: activity corner (art, magic show, tattoo or balloon artist for children)

rituals.significance: Keeps guests of all ages engaged; especially important at children's parties.

rituals.name: Aarti and cake-cutting

items.item: plates and napkins; aarti plate with lamp and sweets for families who do an aarti

rituals.significance: The centrepiece moment: candles, the birthday song and the first slice, often fed to the parents.

rituals.name: Dinner or high tea

items.item: Catering or home-cooked food sized to the guest count

rituals.significance: The meal is usually the largest single cost; plan quantities from the confirmed guest count.

rituals.name: Return gifts and farewell

items.item: Return gifts (one per guest or per family)

rituals.significance: A thank-you to each guest; plan one return gift per child guest or per family.
